description: A public benchmark evaluating Gemini 3.5 Flash on structured field extraction from Indian trade documents. 8 documents, 80 field extractions, Wilson 95% CI throughout.

settings.prompt_strategy: zero-shot, frozen single prompt for all documents

cohort.document_origins: synthetic and redacted samples — no real client data

prompt_schema_note: Each field was returned by the model as {value, evidence, page}. Evidence is a verbatim quote from the document; page is the 1-indexed page number. Only the value field was scored against ground truth in v0.1. Evidence quality scoring is planned for v0.2.

field_accuracy.description: Proportion of all 80 scored fields with exact-match correct value

safe_abstention.description: TP=field present and extracted correctly. FN=field present but missed. TN=field absent and model correctly returned null. FP=field absent but model hallucinated a value.

json_validity.description: All 8 Gemini outputs were valid parseable JSON

evidence_backed_accuracy.note: Prompt requested evidence citations and page numbers per field. Evidence quality was not separately scored in v0.1 — only value fields were evaluated against ground truth. Planned for v0.2.

packing_list.notes: Struggles with letterhead ambiguity for seller vs buyer name

bl_awb.notes: TD-05 AWB: document_date and total_invoice_value correctly returned null

cert_origin.notes: TD-06: 6-digit HS code returned instead of 8-digit

commercial_invoice.notes: TD-07: VTSZ/SZJ HS label recognised; country_of_origin field blank in scan

false_negative.description: Field present in document but Gemini returned null — dominant failure mode

wrong_value.description: Field present, Gemini returned a value, but value was incorrect (e.g. HS code truncation)

false_positive.description: Field absent from document but Gemini hallucinated a value

latency_seconds.note: TD-08 is a 69-line multi-invoice packing list — 6x the median, a production scalability signal

known_limitations: 8 documents is too small for statistical confidence — Wilson CI is wide: [67.2%, 85.3%]
Evidence quality not scored in v0.1 — prompt requested citations but only value fields were evaluated
Single run per document — no variance estimate across runs
All documents are synthetic or redacted — performance on real production documents may differ
Single model tested — no cross-model comparison yet
Temperature 0.0 removes sampling variance but does not eliminate prompt sensitivity
citation: Duraisamy, Y. (2026). TradeDoc-Bench v0.1: Evaluating Gemini 3.5 Flash on Indian trade document extraction. https://paperstreet47.github.io/tradedoc-bench/
